units.title: Introduction to Microbiology in Wastewater Treatment
topics: 1.1. Basic microbiology concepts including metabolic function
1.2. Microbial communities in water and wastewater
1.3. Role of microorganisms in biological treatment
1.4. Microbiology of secondary treatment unit process
uos: 1.a. Describe the Basic microbiology concepts including metabolic function
1.b. Identify Microbial communities in water and wastewater
1.c. Explain the Role of microorganisms in biological treatment
1.d. Describe the Microbiology of secondary treatment unit process

units.title: Biological Treatment Methods
topics: 2.1. Aerobic processes: Activated sludge, oxidation ponds
2.2. Anaerobic processes: Anaerobic digestion, UASB reactor
2.3. Attached growth processes: Trickling filters, RBCs,SAFF,MBBR
uos: 2.d. Explain various Biological treatment for nutrient removal

units.title: Operation and Maintenance of Biological Treatment Systems
topics: 3.4. Troubleshooting common issues in biological treatment like Poor Nutrient Balance, Inadequate Dissolved Oxygen, Foaming in Activated Sludge Systems, Bulking Sludge, pH Fluctuations, High Filamentous Bacteria etc. Biological treatment of waste water Course Code: 4361301
uos: 3.a. Describe Operation and control strategies in biological treatment
3.d. Identify common issues in biological treatment and troubleshoot them

units.title: Advanced Topics and Applications
topics: 4.1. Emerging biological treatment technologies like Anammox (Anaerobic Ammonium Oxidation), Microbial Electrochemical Technologies, Constructed Wetlands with Engineered Microbes, Algal Treatment System, Bioaugmentation with Engineered Microbes etc.
4.3. Future trends in biological treatment of water and wastewater like Resource Recovery from Wastewater, Climate-Resilient Treatment Processes, Microbial Source Tracking etc.
uos: 4.b. Review Case studies and practical applications
4.c. Understand Future trends in biological treatment of water and wastewater
